# julieta completion

print the shell completion script

```
julieta completion <command> [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help   help for completion
```

### SEE ALSO

* [julieta](../julieta.md) - the commands that run inside a sandbox
* [julieta completion bash](completion/bash.md) - print the bash completion script
* [julieta completion fish](completion/fish.md) - print the fish completion script
* [julieta completion zsh](completion/zsh.md) - print the zsh completion script

### Exit codes

| Exit | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | ok |
| 1 | the operation failed |
| 2 | usage or precondition |
| 3 | approval required |
| 4 | drift detected, or an interrupted promotion abandoned |
| 5 | refused to protect data |
| 6 | the check ran and found what it checks for |
| 130 | ended by SIGINT |
| 143 | ended by SIGTERM |

A signal wins over a failure the command had already found (1 to 6); a command that had finished its work keeps 0.
